claims.content: The Customer browses and searches products on the auction site.

goal.raw_text: The Customer browses and searches products on the auction site.

claims.content: Customer
Endeca or Endeca-like search and navigation capability is integrated into the platform solution, with significant drill-down capability.
The home page top-level left navigation includes Category, Product Type, Auction Type, and Current Bid (NOT “Price”!).

All active auction items are searchable by all item attributes, including product ID, auction number, product category, product type, stone type, metal type, current price, as well as full text search on the description field.
No product will ever be eligible to appear on a product details page, search results, or catalog page if it does not have an available image to display.
Closed items have been removed from Category “Browse” Pages / Search Result Pages within 1 minute.
The Customer performs an initial click action on a category from the Home page Top-level Left Navigation.

trigger.raw_text: The Customer performs an initial click action on a category from the Home page Top-level Left Navigation.

claims.content: Customer performs an initial click action on a category in the Home page Top-level Left Navigation, which includes Category, Product Type, Auction Type, and Current Bid.

System displays the Category “Browse” Pages / Search Result Pages with the global site header & footer, a navigational bread crumb trail at the top of the page, and the Endeca navigation section on the left side of the page in an expanded state.
Customer refines the search results using the Endeca navigation section’s drill-down capability.
System displays breadcrumbs on the category page similar to: Home > Browse/search criteria 1 > Additional criteria > Additional criteria.
Customer selects a product from the Catalog Pages.
System displays the Product Details (Bidding) page.

At step 1, multiple page templates are used depending on the user’s initial click action (gemstones, jewelry, watches, jeweler supplies, and collectibles); each template has different title tags and frequently-searched text at the bottom for SEO.
At step 1, items that are closed are removed from the Category “Browse” Pages / Search Result Pages within 1 minute.
At step 2, if the Customer uses Sorting, the System applies the Sorting requirements from the category page navigation requirements.
At step 4, the Customer may navigate from Catalog Pages back to the Home Page.
At step 5, the Customer may navigate from Product Details (Bidding) back to Catalog Pages.
At step 5, the Customer may navigate from Product Details (Bidding) to the Bid Confirm Popup.

The Category “Browse” Pages / Search Result Pages display the global site header & footer, a navigational bread crumb trail at top of page, and the Endeca navigation section on the left side of the page in an expanded state.

Multiple page templates, depending on the user’s initial click action (gemstones, jewelry, watches, jeweler supplies, and collectibles). Each template will have different title tags and frequently-searched text at the bottom for SEO.

Navigation “Breadcrumbs” will appear similar to: Home > Browse/search criteria 1 > Additional criteria > Additional criteria. Breadcrumbs will appear on the category pages and the product details pages.
If the search results in multiple items found, a category / search result page should load, using the default catalog view page.
If there is only one search match, the product details page should load.
No product will ever be eligible to appear on a product details page, search results, or catalog page if it does not have an available image to display.
Items that are closed will be removed within 1 minute.

All active auction items must be searchable by all item attributes, including product ID, auction number, product category, product type, stone type, metal type, current price, as well as full text search on the description field.
Searches should be able to use wildcards.
